The start
function is used to block other relay in the network or as an alarm, the delayed
function for selectivity against other over current relays in the network can
be selected with definite or inverse time delay the instantaneous function is
normally set for close - up faults incases where selectivity against fuses is
required, the definite time delay is used, the low transient over each also
allows for extended reach with smaller settings margins

Setting
is done by means of switches and potentiometers set values are shown on the
display by pushing repeatedly on the " Mode " button , At the same
time, the light emailing diodes (LED) to the left of the potentio meters, for
each protective function will light up with a steady glow

The green
LED mocked " in service " in on , if the internal supervision discovers
an internal fault or the supply voltage is interrupted , the LED will go out and
an alarm relay pick - up. If the " reset " button ( service value ) is
pushed repeatedly , the display will show the actual current in phases R, S, T
and N, while the cores pending R, S, T or N LED will light up.

items:
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating
 the relay current circuits for test
Switch on the MeB for DC supply

Connect test leads between the current terminals on the
 relay (3A,4A) and the current terminals on the test set this for phase R.

Slowly increase the current until the relay operate the
 relay must be operate with a current between + 10 % of the setting
 value
Record this value on the test sheet

Increase the injected current to value 25 % greater than
 the operating value
Slowly decrease the current until the relay rest
Record this value on the test sheet

Divided the reset current by the operating current to obtain
 the reset factor which must be less than 85 %

Change the test leady between the current terminals on the
 relay (5 A , 6A) and (7A , 8A) for phases S and T
Repeat the steps from 1 to 7 for phases S and T

Inject current into relay until the relay picks up. Keep
 this value and switch off the test set

Connect the relay time delayed out put contacts (1A,7A) to
 the timer contact of the test set

Switch on the test set the timer start and will stop once the
 relay has picked up
Record this value on the test sheet

Make a final check that all switches on the relay are set
 according to the setting sheet
Make sure the CT secondary circuits is in normal condition
Return the relay to service
